title: What Intention Locks Internals Is All About
description: Signaling intent up the lock hierarchy: IS, IX, SIX and multi-granularity locking.. This database covers Intention Locks Internals with full records: definitions, key facts, working procedures, and runnable demo programs, arranged on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced. definition: Intention Locks Internals — Signaling intent up the lock hierarchy: IS, IX, SIX and multi-granularity locking.

title: How it works
description: How it works. Take IX on the table before X on rows; a table-level S request sees the IX and waits. One check at the top instead of a million below. Elegant and efficient.
definition: How it works — Take IX on the table before X on rows; a table-level S request sees the IX and waits.
key_points: Take IX on the table before X on rows; a table-level S request sees the IX and waits.
One check at the top instead of a million below.
Elegant and efficient.
MVCC lets readers avoid blocking writers; it's the modern default.
Write-ahead logging orders log before data; violating it corrupts.
